verdict.rationale: Logseq is marketed as a 'privacy-first, open-source knowledge base' with local-first storage and end-to-end encrypted sync, meaning user data by default lives in local markdown files rather than being sent to a vendor cloud for AI training. However, there is no explicit policy, setting, or documentation addressing AI training data usage specifically, and community feedback (logseq-comm-20) notes the 'privacy-first' branding is undercut by a vague privacy policy with more tracking/analytics than expected. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or setting about AI training data exclusion, and independent confirmation that no telemetry/data is used to train models.
